Lululemon Cuts Revenue Forecast Amid Sales Challenges

Lululemon Athletica has again lowered its revenue forecast, citing challenges for its new CEO, Heidi O'Neill. The company's shares dropped significantly, with one report stating a 20% fall, after it announced a reduced full-year sales outlook. The sportswear maker experienced a notable decline in sales from its signature leggings business. Competitors such as Alo and Vuori are reportedly gaining market share in the athleisure sector, presenting further challenges for Lululemon in regaining customer spending.
